title: Pupil PDF worksheet (draw and tick; printable or for a drawing tablet) (lesson 7)
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y1 lesson 7 (Pupil PDF worksheet (draw and tick; printable or for a drawing tablet))
intro: Lesson 7: Likes, dislikes and being special. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

panels.title: We are all different
points: Different faces? No: we talk about likes

blocks.title: Sort into: I like / I do not like
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: I like, I do not like.

panels.title: Allah made us different
points: So we can know one another

blocks.text: Draw objects, food or places (no people). Show your sheet to the camera.

keywords.def: there is only one of you
not the same as anyone else

questions.q: Finish the sentence: 'I am special because I ...'
questions.a: For example: 'I am special because I am good at helping.'

questions.q: Pupil PDF: draw two things you like (objects, food or places, no people) and one thing you do not like. Show it to the camera.
questions.a: Two likes and one dislike drawn.

questions.q: Extend: say one thing you like that your friend does not.
questions.a: For example: 'I like carrots, but my friend does not.'

questions.q: Why did Allah make people different (49:13)?
options: So we can know one another
questions.a: A) So we can know one another. 49:13: 'that you may know one another'.

questions.q: Think again: If everyone in the world liked exactly the same food, games and colours, would the world be better or more boring?
questions.a: More boring! Allah made us different so we can learn from each other.
